description: This Java interface defines a contract for battery-powered devices, including methods to set and get low battery status and battery voltage.

classes.name: BatteryPowered
classes.description: An interface specifying methods related to battery status and voltage for battery-powered devices.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Method to set the device into a low battery state.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Method to retrieve the current low battery state status.

methods.name: setBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Method to set the current battery voltage.

methods.name: getBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Method to obtain the current battery voltage.
